"""Fill text greedily into lines of at most `width` characters, keeping paragraphs."""
import re


def wrap(text, width):
    if isinstance(width, bool) or not isinstance(width, int) or width < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"width must be an integer >= 1: {width!r}")
    paragraphs = []
    for para in re.split(r"\n[^\S\n]*(?:\n[^\S\n]*)*", "\n" + text):
        words = para.split()
        if not words:
            continue
        line = words[0]
        lines = []
        for word in words[1:]:
            if len(line) + 1 + len(word) <= width:
                line += " " + word
            else:
                lines.append(line)
                line = word
        lines.append(line)
        paragraphs.append("\n".join(lines))
    return "\n\n".join(paragraphs)

cat > tests/test_wrap.py <<'EOF'
import contextlib
import io
import unittest

from textkit.cli import main
from textkit.wrap import wrap


def run(*argv):
    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
        code = main(list(argv))
    return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()


class WrapTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_greedy(self):
        self.assertEqual(wrap("aaa bbb ccc", 7), "aaa bbb\nccc")
        self.assertEqual(wrap("aaa bbb ccc", 11), "aaa bbb ccc")

    def test_collapse_whitespace(self):
        self.assertEqual(wrap("a \t b\nc", 10), "a b c")

    def test_paragraphs(self):
        self.assertEqual(wrap("\n\n a b\n \n\t\n\nc d\n\n", 3), "a b\n\nc d")

    def test_long_and_hyphenated(self):
        self.assertEqual(wrap("a abcdefghij b", 4), "a\nabcdefghij\nb")
        self.assertEqual(wrap("x well-known y", 5), "x\nwell-known\ny")

    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(wrap("  \n ", 5), "")

    def test_bad_width(self):
        for w in (0, -1):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                wrap("x", w)

    def test_cli(self):
        self.assertEqual(run("wrap", "aaa bbb ccc", "--width", "7"), (0, "aaa bbb\nccc\n", ""))
        code, out, err = run("wrap", "x", "--width", "0")
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertTrue(err.startswith("error:"))

    def test_cli_default_width(self):
        code, out, _ = run("wrap", " ".join(["word"] * 20))
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(all(len(l) <= 40 for l in out.splitlines()))

    def test_listed(self):
        self.assertIn("wrap\n", run("commands")[1])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
